name: charity-register-five-year-exit
description: Will a charity newly entered on the Register of Charities for England and Wales be removed from the register within five years of its registration date?
split_description: Chronological by date_of_registration: train = registrations from 2015-01-01 through 2016-12-31; eval = 2017-01-01 through 2017-12-31; holdout = 2018-01-01 through 2018-12-31. No embargo is applied because every input is fixed at the row's own registration date and the label is the row's own forward five-year exit; there are no lagged, rolling or cross-row features. All five-year outcome windows close by 2023-12-31, well before the extract date.
